gate.rule: All 12 evidence pairs must be correct and valid; median paired delegated selection-to-dispatch time must be at least 10 percent lower. Routine cases are negative controls. This exploratory gate is not proof of general benefit.

limitations: Six authored fictional short-context cases with three paired repeats; no statistical significance or general task-quality claim.
Commands were submitted to a measurement sink, not executed; latency is decision-to-dispatch time, not workflow time.
Both arms used identical fixed tools, profiles and facts; the direct arm is not unmodified native Pi.
Profile authoring, evidence gathering, initialization and final acknowledgements are excluded; delegation was forced only to measure its cost, including routine negative controls.
Server caches and service variation cannot be controlled. Cache usage is recorded.
The 10-second benchmark timeout differs from the 1.5-second production default.
Reasoning tokens are already included in output; tokens do not represent actual subscription charges.
One live preflight and historical experiments are excluded from statistics. Local data only, no charts or public performance report.

Two dependency version labels in the plugin lockfile disagreed with their resolved tarballs; the installed and executed lambda-invoke-store packages were version 0.3.0. A follow-up metadata correction does not change the frozen results.
